POV: you found the good Bún Quậy in Phu Quoc.

Bún Quậy Cô Thắm sits in Xóm Làng Chài, away from the tourist strips. 4.8 stars. 82 reviews. Locals keep coming back.

Price sits at $15-30 a person. For a family bowl spot this good, that's nothing.

Go hungry. Order everything.
